meta.model: 4phase_L24 detector + β=0 self-mask masker + posterior product (s x bimod x pfg_mean)
meta.notes: per tile: boxes_2048 = xyxy in 2048px tile coords; masks_rle = pycocotools RLE at mask_res (divide boxes by scale_box_to_mask to align with masks); scores = detector confidence (filter >= op_thr for the operating point); canopy_ignore[i]=True means pred i sits >50% in canopy (ignored, not a false positive).
